title: AI for All: Operationalising Diversity and Inclusion Requirements for AI Systems
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the ability of a human focus group and a Large Language Model (GPT-4) to elicit and articulate Diversity and Inclusion (D&I) requirements in AI systems using a tailored user story template. Specifically related to religion, it measured how well these actors identified and incorporated religious sensitivities and accommodations (e.g., facial recognition for users wearing religious headgear like niqabs or hijabs, and avoiding AI conflict with patient religious beliefs in healthcare) into system requirements.
findings: Both the human focus group and GPT-4 successfully generated D&I user stories that addressed religious inclusion. The human analysts generated a specific requirement for a Muslim woman wearing a niqab to use a facial recognition system securely. GPT-4 generated similar requirements, such as ensuring a female employee wearing a hijab is accurately recognized by facial recognition, and ensuring a healthcare AI system alerts professionals about potential conflicts between a treatment plan and a patient's religious or cultural beliefs.
